title: Cloud Security Basics: Understanding the Shared Responsibility Model | Cloud and Mobile Security Cou
short_hook: Who is responsible for your cloud data security?
description:
Learn the Shared Responsibility Model in cloud security. Discover how duties are divided between providers and customers across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms. In this lesson: Understand the core security framework, compare IaaS vs PaaS vs SaaS responsibilities, and see real-world examples of OS updates and configuration risks. This is lesson 1 of our complete Cloud and Mobile Security course - watch the full playlist from the beginning. Ask your doubts in the comments.
